decisions.reason: As an extension of an existing app offering, the XL package is closely related to the firm's core business and likely inexpensive to keep available, so real-options logic favors waiting longer for demand to become clearer rather than abandoning it after roughly one year.

The support service is more resource-intensive than a software package and may be tested more critically, but because it is still early and the offer can generate learning and customer lock-in in the dental market, management would more likely keep the option open for now.
